name: Luke Edmonds
why: Herald photograph of the SGA presidential debate of 10 April 2017, whose caption names one person only and gives him his SGA office. The bearded man in the blue check shirt and red tie is the only figure in the plane of focus, the only full face in the frame, and the only person watching the front of the room, so he is the named senator. Edmonds is listed in the archive for 2015-16 and the frame is from his continuing service in April 2017; filed under the archive's year for him.
